title: Sidney Bechet's friendship with Armstrong and staying in Paris
summary: Bechet and Armstrong stayed friends, and Bechet remained in Europe where he was like a king.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Yeah. Were Sidney Bechet and Louis Armstrong pretty good friends? Oh yeah.
Well they're all boys around here, you see? Yeah. They come up and all...
You mean did they remain friends all through life?

Yeah. They did, you know? Uh-huh. Sometimes you guys have a little thing they don't like. Sometimes they... I'm sorry. They died friends. I mean you made like a little arguments or something. Oh well no. But I mean they're all friends.
Why did Bechet stay in Paris? Didn't want to come back at all?

Well Sidney was around New York. He was doing alright in New York. But he went over in that foreign country over there. That's what made him so big. He went over there. He had been going over there for years. Uh-huh. And he decided to stay over there. Well he was like a king over there. And that would have been a big man in this country like he's over there.
That's what he was. It was a big thing.
